packageRules.description: Keep the conventional-commits preset below v10 until semantic-release upgrades to conventional-changelog-writer v9; v10 otherwise generates header-only release notes. Track semantic-release/release-notes-generator#992 and #996.
Root JavaScript versions stay exact and use Bun lock ownership. Workers npm ranges remain independent.
Review every stable Bun toolchain upgrade together; both .bun-version and packageManager must agree before frozen installation.
Retained Deno import mappings are public metadata, not a second development dependency graph. Coordinate ranges with reviewed root upgrades.
The independent Workers lock uses its reviewed npm 10 toolchain, never root Bun.
